rationale: For a government compliance and job search tracker app, trust, clarity, and authority are paramount. A Swiss & High-Contrast design ensures the data density is manageable, forms are highly legible, and the application feels official and functional.

rules: Use dense, highly structured grids for the dashboard (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6.
Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8 internally.
Never center forms; left-align all inputs and labels for high readability.
Use subgrid where necessary to maintain alignment across rows.

surface_strategies.cards: Grid Borders: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), crisp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), no shadows.
surface_strategies.hover_states: Slight border color darkening, extremely subtle bg-slate-50 shifts, avoid floating shadow effects to maintain the grounded, physical paper-like compliance feel.
surface_strategies.header: Solid White Background with a hard 1px bottom border to clearly separate navigation from the workspace.

component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select components. All form fields MUST have clear, visible labels. No placeholder-only inputs.
component_rules.buttons: Flat, sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Primary buttons use the Illinois Blue (#0033A0) with high-contrast white text.
component_rules.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Dense rows for the Work Search Contact log to maximize data visibility without scrolling.
component_rules.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for edit/delete confirmations.
component_rules.toast: Use Sonner for audit log notifications and form success messages.

icons.instructions: Use Phosphor icons with 'regular' or 'bold' weight to match the technical Swiss aesthetic.

login.layout: Split screen. Left side: High-contrast authentication form. Right side: Hero image of Chicago Skyline with a dark 40% overlay and the state emblem or large typography.

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid. Top row: Key compliance metrics (Weeks Logged, Total Contacts, Active Status). Main area: Data table of recent Work Search Contacts. Sidebar or top nav for quick actions.

claimant_profile.layout: Standard vertical form. Fields: First Name, Last Name, MI, ID/SSN. Left-aligned, generous padding.

work_search_log.layout: Complex data table matching the ADJ034F form columns. Editable rows or slide-out panel for editing/adding: Week Ending, Contact Date, Name & Address, Method, Type of Work, Results.

import_page.layout: Large dropzone area in the center using dashed 2px borders. Supported formats highlighted (CSV, PNG, JPG). Include an audit list below showing successfully parsed records.

audit_log.layout: Full-width technical data table showing timestamps, actions (Login, Form Created, PDF Download), and User ID.

images.description: Chicago skyline, used for the login/registration split-screen background to add local context and visual interest.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, dropdowns) MUST have a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based (e.g., data-testid='submit-work-search-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Use the primary Illinois Blue (#0033A0) only for primary actions.
Install and use @phosphor-icons/react for all icons.
Implement Google Fonts for 'Chivo' (headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (body) in index.html.
Build the dashboard using the Control Room Grid strategy (dense, highly structured).
Ensure all forms have high contrast, explicit labels, and 1px sharp borders. Do not use soft shadows.
The Work Search log must closely mirror the ADJ034F form columns for compliance.
Ensure the PDF generation matches the required ADJ034F structure as closely as possible.
